title: VIPER LT SYSTEM
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.247-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 7 (36C247)
description_text: The Central AL VA Medical Center is seeking a compact automated bench-top molecular diagnostic platform designed for low- to mid-volume laboratories, primarily utilized for HPV testing and STI screening. That offers fully automated molecular testing, integrating sample extraction, real-time PCR amplification, and detection in a single system.
